headline: Approved $18,806.00 payout for former Police Chief Scott McNamara's accrued vacation time.
summary: Chair Soto asked that the payment be brought back the correct way, and the city solicitor said it would not put the city in a negative predicament. decision_titles: $18,806.00 vacation payout to former Police Chief Scott McNamara
plain_text:
METHUEN CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING 
THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 24, 2026 AT 6:00 p.m. 
VIA ZOOM 
 
 Chair Soto called the special meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. via Zoom.  Members present:  
Councilor Valley, Councilor DiZoglio, Councilor Drew, Councilor Marsan, Councilor Pesce, 
Councilor Santos, and Chair Soto.  Councilor MacLaren and Councilor Simard were absent. 
 TR-26-88 A Resolution Authorizing the Mayor and CAFO to pay Scott McNamara, the 
former Police Chief, for his remaining four weeks of already accrued vacation time, 
notwithstanding the terms under his employment contract that the city did in August 1st, 2023, 
and appropriating $18,806.00 for the purpose (sponsored by the Mayor) (EPA Requested) 
 MOTION BY: Councilor Pesce, seconded by Councilor Valley to approve.   
Chair Soto said she just wants to make sure that the way we are bringing this back is the 
correct way to do this in the Solicitor’s professional opinion and that the Council isn’t doing 
anything that is going to put us in a negative predicament with public funds. 
Solicitor O’Neill responded, no, (this will not put you in a negative predicament).  
(Minutes amended 10-5-2026 CC meeting.) Council can certainly approve this if they wish.   
UPON ROLL CALL VOTE:  7 yes, 2 absent (Councilor MacLaren, Councilor Simard) 
EPA REQUESTED 
MOTION BY:  Councilor Drew, seconded by Councilor Pesce to approve an EPA. 
MOTION BY:  Councilor Santos, seconded by Councilor DiZoglio to approve, 
UPON VOTE:  8 yes, 1 absent (Clr. Pesce) 
 
The Methuen City Council will vote on entering Executive Session, in accordance with 
Exemption 7, under M.G.L. c. 30A § 23(b). If the City Council votes to enter into Executive 
Session, the City Council will discuss and vote on the acceptance/disclosure of the executive 
session meeting minutes for the following dates: 
  
• 5/4/2020 
• 11/7/2022 
• 1/17/2023 
• 4/3/2023 
• 5/1/2023 
• 6/13/2023 
• 7/10/2023 
• 10/16/2023 
 
Following the conclusion of the Executive Session, the City Council will adjourn and not 
reconvene in open session.
METHUEN CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING 
THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 24, 2026 AT 6:00 p.m. 
VIA ZOOM 
MOTION BY:  Councilor Drew, seconded by Councilor Pesce to enter Executive Session. 
UPON ROLL CALL VOTE:  7 yes, 2 absent (Councilor MacLaren, Councilor Simard) 
Chair Soto announced Council would not reconvene in open session. 
 
     COUNCIL CLERK
